scope: Bounded X5 research after issue12/PR13 evidence-method clarification; partial evidence, not complete corpus classification
methodology: Catalogue-level market compatibility may qualify without live stock. Current neutral official brand/category records plus current official SPB/LO chain presence are evaluated. Material purchase qualifiers remain mandatory. Other-city titles/store bindings, expired flyers, food composition within unrelated prepared products, and unverified aggregators are excluded. Live access failure remains UNCERTAIN and is not a data-impossibility conclusion.
